/images/ceh/m03-03-01-connect-flow-zh.sv:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0303-f1-zh-title m0303-f1-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0303-f1-zh-title">圖 1｜TCP Connect 的典型流程</title>
<desc id="m0303-f1-zh-desc">作業系統嘗試建立TCP連線，完成交握後回報結果，工具再結束測試連線。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0303-f1-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 1｜TCP Connect 的典型流程</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">呼叫作業系統 connect</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">指定核准的 IP 與 TCP 連接埠</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">例：192.0.2.20:443</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">開始三向交握</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">測試端送 SYN</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">伺服器回 SYN＋ACK</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">完成基本交握</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">作業系統送 ACK</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">取得連線成功或錯誤結果</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">記錄並結束測試</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">保留方法、時間與系統回報</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">服務內容依任務另外查核</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">合成流程；連線建立與網站功能各有查核結果。</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m03-03-02-syn-flow-zh.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0303-f2-zh-title m0303-f2-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0303-f2-zh-title">圖 2｜SYN 掃描的典型開放回應</title>
<desc id="m0303-f2-zh-desc">SYN掃描觀察起始回應，典型開放案例收到SYN加ACK後以RST結束嘗試。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0303-f2-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 2｜SYN 掃描的典型開放回應</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">送出 TCP SYN</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">核准來源 → 192.0.2.20:443</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">觀察建立連線的起始回應</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">收到 SYN＋ACK</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">符合此方法的開放回應特徵</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">記錄回覆來源與時間</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">以 RST 結束嘗試</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">不繼續一般交握的最後 ACK</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">保留實際控制旗標紀錄</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">整理工具判讀</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">此情境按 SYN 方法記 open</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">方法、回應與後續查核分欄</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">典型紙上案例；權限與封包細節依執行環境。</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m03-03-03-udp-responses-zh.s:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0303-f3-zh-title m0303-f3-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0303-f3-zh-title">圖 3｜UDP 回應的四種判讀</title>
<desc id="m0303-f3-zh-desc">四張並列卡片代表不同可能結果；UDP回覆、ICMP錯誤與逾時各自對應方法狀態。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0303-f3-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 3｜UDP 回應的四種判讀</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">對應 UDP 回覆 → open</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">核對目標連接埠及回覆關係</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">保留送出的酬載與回應</text>
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">IPv4 ICMP 3／3 → closed</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Type 3、Code 3：連接埠無法到達</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">核對回報來源與原始探測</text>
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">特定其他 ICMP 錯誤 → filtered</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">依工具定義與實際類型判讀</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">保留完整類型、代碼與來源</text>
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">重試後無回覆 → open|filtered</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">保留開放或過濾的可能</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">再查查詢格式、政策與服務設定</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">四種不同結果並列；Type／Code 例子適用 IPv4。</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m03-03-04-evidence-layers-zh:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0303-f4-zh-title m0303-f4-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0303-f4-zh-title">圖 4｜讓掃描狀態連回實際證據</title>
<desc id="m0303-f4-zh-desc">先記探測與回應，再記工具判讀；依目的查核服務及政策，保留測試條件與差異。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0303-f4-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 4｜讓掃描狀態連回實際證據</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">原始觀察</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">送了什麼、收到什麼、等了多久</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">來源、目的、協定、埠與時間</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">工具判讀</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Connect／SYN／UDP 各有規則</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">open、closed、filtered 等狀態</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">服務與政策查核</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">監聽設定、TLS、HTTP 與用途</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">依任務及授權範圍選擇檢查</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">驗收及差異追蹤</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">比對預期清單、日誌與複測結果</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">保留版本、速率、等待與重試設定</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">每項結論均可追溯；舊觀察保留供比較。</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m03-03-01-connect-flow-en.sv:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0303-f1-en-title m0303-f1-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0303-f1-en-title">1 | A typical TCP Connect scan</title>
<desc id="m0303-f1-en-desc">The operating system attempts a TCP connection, completes the handshake and reports the result; the tool then ends the test connection.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0303-f1-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">1 | A typical TCP Connect scan</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Call the operating system connect interface</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Specify approved IP and TCP port</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Example: 192.0.2.20:443</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f1-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Begin the three-way handshake</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">The test endpoint sends SYN</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">The server responds with SYN+ACK</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f1-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Complete the basic handshake</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">The operating system sends ACK</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Obtain connection success or an error</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f1-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Record and end the test</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Retain method, time and system result</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Check service content separately as required</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Synthetic flow; connection and web function are separate checks.</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m03-03-02-syn-flow-en.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0303-f2-en-title m0303-f2-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0303-f2-en-title">2 | A typical open response to a SYN scan</title>
<desc id="m0303-f2-en-desc">A SYN scan examines the initial response; in a typical open case, SYN+ACK is followed by RST to end the attempt.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0303-f2-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">2 | A typical open response to a SYN scan</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Send TCP SYN</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Approved source → 192.0.2.20:443</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Observe the initial connection response</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f2-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Receive SYN+ACK</text>
